info.name: Sana3y API - صنايعي
info.description:
Complete API collection for Sana3y platform - connecting customers with craftsmen in Egypt.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT Bearer token. Use the auth endpoints to get tokens.

## Environment Variables
- `baseUrl`: API base URL (e.g., http://localhost:5000)
- `token`: JWT access token (auto-set after login)
- `refreshToken`: JWT refresh token
- `phone`: Test phone number
- `craftsmanId`: Test craftsman ID
- `customerId`: Test customer ID
- `requestId`: Test request ID
- `categoryId`: Test category ID

request.description: Send OTP to phone number for verification
